comments.author: RoyalSpecialist1777
comments.body:
I personally found it unplayable.  Not sure how other people picked it up so fast without complaint.  
  
I just played the tutorial and messed it up bad.  First the same finger I press 'R' with to boost is what I press 'd' with to go to the right so I couldn't jump over the gap as I kept messing it up.  Second I have no idea why but my weapon suddenly became limp and I could not aim more than a tiny bit.  Third I kept pressing space as my brain associates that with flying or other things not 'fire', I would prefer 'enter' be 'fire' as it ends the turn.    
  
Overall I give it a C as I was unable to get past the tutorial without getting really frustrated.
